web.description:
According to the Washington Business Journal, the [first phase](https://www.bizjournals.com/washington/news/2026/07/21/plaza-500-south-starwood-alexandria-edsall.html?utm_source=st&utm_medium=en&utm_campaign=ae&utm_content=WA&j=46678278&senddate=2026-07-21&utm_term=ep4&empos=p4) calls for a 75-foot-tall data center over 226,469 square feet.

Data center development on the Plaza 500 site is by right based on permitted zoning.

However, what’s under review is a [Edsall Road substation](https://www.dominionenergy.com/about/delivering-energy/electric-projects/power-line-projects/edsall) Dominion Energy proposed to power the Plaza 500 data center project.
